The Vampire Miranda Sanova says that if a Brujah attemps to block her, then
that Brujah has a -1 intercept. My question is if A vampire can have an
intercept of less than zero. I.e. If I bleed my prey with Miranda, does he
have to use an intercept card to be able to block her with a brujah, or
is zero the "minimum" intercept. Thanks for the help.

more easily than other vampires, so they need to increase their intercept to
block even normal-stealth actions she takes.

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Tazer One <war...@nightshade.cs.odu.edu> wrote:
>The Vampire Miranda Sanova says that if a Brujah attemps to block her, then
>that Brujah has a -1 intercept. My question is if A vampire can have an
>intercept of less than zero. I.e. If I bleed my prey with Miranda, does he
>have to use an intercept card to be able to block her with a brujah, or
>is zero the "minimum" intercept. Thanks for the help.

Yes, it is possible for a vampire to have negative intercept or stealth,
just very difficult. A Brujah attempting to block even the most basic
action by Miranda, such as a bleed, would need an intercept card to do so.
